```yaml
name: Sync Open WebUI

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-open-webui:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Remove leftover submodule
        run: |
          git submodule deinit -f open-webui
          rm -rf .git/modules/open-webui
          git rm -f open-webui

      - name: Clone Open WebUI as shallow copy
        run: |
          rm -rf open-webui
          git clone --depth 1 --no-checkout https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui.git open-webui
          cd open-webui
          git checkout HEAD -- .
          cd ..

      - name: Update contributor docs
        run: |
          echo "# Open WebUI Integration" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "This project includes Open WebUI as a submodule. The latest version is automatically synced weekly." >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "## Folder Structure" >> CONTRIBUTING.md
          echo "- \`open-webui/\` - Contains the Open WebUI source code" >> CONTRIBUTING.md

      - name: Update README
        run: |
          sed -i '/## Development/a ## Automated Sync\n\nOpen WebUI is automatically synchronized weekly from the upstream repository.' README.md

      - name: Exclude cloned repo from builds
        run: |
          echo "open-webui/" >> .gitignore

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: 'chore: sync open-webui'
          author_name: 'GitHub Actions'
          author_email: 'actions@github.com'
          push: true

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pip install nox
          nox -s lint tests
```
